article.title: 案例：Travis以Finalytics調整網站內容，按訪客意圖呈現下一步
article.title_en: Case study: Travis uses Finalytics to adapt website content to visitor intent
article.summary: Finalytics於11月2日宣布，Travis Credit Union的個人化網站體驗已上線。
article.summary_en: Finalytics announced a live personalized website experience for Travis Credit Union on November 2.
highlights: 按網站行為調整內容、產品資訊及下一步。
供應商亦支援文案、優惠及報告；未公布轉換提升數據。
highlights_en: Website behavior informs content, offers and next steps.
The vendor also supports copy and reporting; no conversion uplift is reported.
article.why: 品牌做個人化時，可以先由訪客要完成的任務設計內容，再決定技術。
article.why_en: Brands can design personalization around visitor tasks before choosing technology.
article.next_step: 選一條查詢或申請路徑，定義完成率及人工覆核標準。
article.next_step_en: Choose one inquiry or application journey and define completion measures and review criteria.
article.detail: 按公司新聞稿，平台由訪客在網站上的行為判斷需要，例如了解首個戶口或比較汽車貸款，再調整頁面內容與提示。Finalytics亦提供背後的文案及報告支援，評估方向包括開戶與實際完成的貸款。這是供應商公布的客戶案例，並非獨立比較實驗；公告未列出轉換提升或對照組，因此不能推斷個人化必然增加收入，也不能套用到其他品牌。
article.detail_en: The vendor says site behavior informs pages for tasks such as opening an account or comparing auto loans. It supports content and reporting, measuring opened accounts and funded loans. This is an attributed customer case without a reported control group or uplift.
